about.label: /About me
about.intro: Hi, I'm Miguel Angel, a full-stack developer with more than 8 years of experience, based in Cuautitlán Izcalli, State of Mexico. I studied Computer Science at Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM). I specialize in LMS platforms, internal systems, and robust APIs with .NET and Vue, plus mobile development with Flutter. Honorable mention at the Salud Digna AI Nutrition Challenge (Talent Land Jalisco 2023), where I built an AI-powered nutrition app using OpenAI agents. Native Spanish, intermediate English.
